title: Placement
description: Where the graph sits during gameplay. auto: osu! and catch use the band right of the playfield (lower half), taiko the space below the lane, mania a vertical strip at the right screen edge. left/right: the band left or right of the playfield (osu!, catch), that end below the lane (taiko), or that screen edge (mania).

title: Nudge X / px
description: Moves the graph right (negative: left) from its placement, in 1080p pixels.

title: Nudge Y / px
description: Moves the graph down (negative: up) from its placement, in 1080p pixels.

title: Graph thickness / px
description: Strain plot height (width for the vertical mania strip); clamped to 32–120 px.

title: Skills
description: combined = one silhouette of the summed skill strains. per-skill = the same silhouette split into stacked bands: osu! aim and speed, taiko colour, rhythm and stamina. Catch (movement) and mania (strains) have a single skill.

title: Show time
description: Time axis labels and the elapsed / total clock.

title: Show kiai and breaks
description: Marks kiai (accent strip) and break (hatched) sections. vosu reports them as the map clock passes them, in play and in the song-select preview; each map remembers the sections already seen.

title: Show in song select
description: Full-map strain preview following the preview clock, low in the free centre column between the leaderboard and the carousel (osu! shows no strain graph there). Results and other screens show nothing.

title: Backing
description: none: marks and text float on the game. scrim: a soft dark fade behind the graph for bright backgrounds. panel: an 18-LAB graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: map: tint the graph with the beatmap background's colour (M3 tonal spot). 18-lab: always the 18-LAB amber.
